criteria.description: Continuation forms a coherent, grammatical standalone tweet when appended to the prefix "I'm scared a college is gonna " — it completes the thought without awkward syntax or a non-sequitur.

Preserves the scared, casual, lowercase-friendly voice and stance of the prefix; allows deliberate informality, nonstandard spelling, '..' run-ons, slashes and fragments, and rewards a specific concrete image or joke over stock hyperbole like 'one of the most miserable experiences ever' or 'never ... again lol'.

Is economical and constraint-compliant: roughly 15 words (ideally 10-20), full tweet including prefix is <=280 characters, does not repeat the prefix, does not invent a link or hashtag, does not discuss the task, and outputs only the remaining text.
